comment: Single source of write permissions. First matching glob wins. ** = any depth, * = one path segment. Owners: template (fleet/** and templates/**; only fleet/scripts/upgrade.sh, BOT_FLEET_UPGRADE=1), manager, builder (local/shared/SHARED-SKILLS.md, the fleet shared skills index, and local/prompts/** compiled prompts; these rules are before local/** so they win), self (bots/<slug>/ = bot <slug>). The builder is the bot whose HEAD:local/fleet.json role is builder and whose status is not retired or paused (the working tree does not count). upgrade.sh may write the shared index. The manager may only add it when the staged bytes equal the committed template stub. Other roles cannot change it. Bots' own files stay owned by the bots. When HEAD:local/fleet.json sets board, owners.py also lets the manager and the coordinator create or delete that file, and lets every non-retired bot update it. A bot may add or update only its own cards; the coordinator's scan audits that, because this check is file-level. The default path local/shared/state/board.md is listed below; any other board.path under local/ is the same rule. When board is omitted the feature is off and the path stays manager-owned. Audit fails a path that matches two owner classes, except local/shared/SHARED-SKILLS.md and paths under local/prompts/. 'create' lists roles that may ADD new files under a self-owned tree (seeding a new bot / restore). examples/** exists only in the template repo (not copied to fleets; validated there only); in a fleet it is read-only if present. template/** and manager/** hold only 0.10.0 compatibility symlinks to the old paths (fleet/scripts/compat.sh); removed after every live prompt is re-rendered.
